title: Tofu and Sweet Potato Curry
subtitle: with Yellow Rice and Snow Pea Sprouts
description: Made without coconut milk, this vegan curry is light, bright and packed with good things: sweet potato, satay tofu and crunchy snow pea sprouts. Serve with turmeric-scented rice for extra colour and flavour.

steps.text: Cook yellow rice: Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Rinse the rice until the water runs clear. Put in a small saucepan with half the garlic, ½ tsp turmeric and 250ml (1 cup) water, cover and bring to a simmer over medium heat. Reduce the heat to low and cook for 12 mins or until tender and the water is absorbed. Turn off the heat and stand, covered, for at least 5 mins.
Prep ingredients: Meanwhile, peel the sweet potato, then cut into 1.5cm chunks. Cut the tofu into 2cm chunks. Trim the snow pea sprouts, then cut into 3-4cm lengths.

Brown tofu: Heat 1 tbs vegetable oil in a medium deep frypan over high heat. Cook the tofu, stirring, for 1-2 mins until browned. Remove from the pan. Add the sweet potato to the pan, reduce the heat to medium and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 mins or until browned. Add 3 tsp curry paste and the remaining garlic and cook, stirring, for 1-2 mins until fragrant.

Simmer curry: Add 180ml (¾ cup) boiling water, 2 tsp white vinegar and 1 tsp sugar to the pan. Season well with salt and pepper and bring to a simmer. Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, stirring occasionally, for 5 mins or until the liquid is reduced and the sweet potato is tender.

Serve up: Add the tofu to the curry and cook, stirring, for 1 min or until warmed through. Remove the pan from the heat. Season the rice with salt and pepper, then divide among bowls. Top with the curry and snow pea sprouts and enjoy!
Make it yours: For a milder, creamy version, stir some coconut milk into the curry in step 4. Or add crunch and scatter with crispy fried shallots before serving.
